note: bottom-guide-r1 (bottom-20261114, offline candidate). Needs bottom_owner.json enabled (uses its scope: landing .. curve-4 FLOOR / t_max_s). enabled true AND hold and/or curl true = on; enabled false or both false = live_pid never calls the module. hold: lost frames where the bottom-owner RATE_HOLD acts get centre + straight_offset_us + kappa/gain(v) + k_psi*(psi - profile(s)) + k_gz*(gz + kappa*v) within -lim_left_us..+lim_right_us; psi = yaw - yaw at the first steep frame (left +), s = rear-encoder distance since the landing, profile = median of 32 IMU passes 11-13/11-14, kappa = profile slope 0.25-0.75 m ahead (0..50 deg/m); profile beyond 4.5 m continued at -24.8 deg/m; only for s <= s_max_m. hold_pwm: number = PWM cap on those frames, null = unchanged. curl: a single-left estimate whose left boundary bends left at the top (curl > curl_max) for curl_frames consecutive scope frames is turned into a lost frame. Read once per run (LivePID.start).
note_r2: bottom-guide-r2 (bottom-20261115, offline candidate): cap_lag opens the bottom-owner cap by k*(lag-deg0) <= max_us while the heading lags the distance profile; corr_right uses the baseline when bottom-left-r1 keeps a corridor that is > gap less right than the baseline and lag > lag_deg; lag_lost turns a valid frame with lag > lag_deg and image error < e_max into a lost frame (profile hold). null / absent = off. Read once per run (LivePID.start).
